stage3.note: The approved Stage 3 hero shot, its own camera keys and reveal tracks.

beats.label: Reactor building
beats.takeaway: The reactor building beside the turbine hall.

beats.label: Containment
beats.takeaway: A containment vessel inside the shaft.

beats.label: Core
beats.takeaway: This is where the nuclear heat is produced.

beats.label: Fission
beats.takeaway: Fission in the fuel releases heat (Stage 10 inset).

beats.label: Natural circulation
beats.takeaway: Water boils in the core; the mixture rises through the chimney; separators and dryer leave dry steam.

beats.label: Turbine and generator
beats.takeaway: Steam turns the turbine, which drives the generator: electricity.

beats.label: Control
beats.takeaway: Control blades between the fuel set the reactor power.

beats.label: Passive cooling
beats.takeaway: Isolation condensers in pools above the reactor can cool it without pumps or operators.

beats.label: Final
beats.takeaway: The whole plant again: a stable end frame.
